$comment: Human-editable editorial/meta overrides. Edit this ONE file to change a page's title, description, or index status WITHOUT touching code or hunting through content/*.ts. Key = route path (leading slash, no domain). Supported fields: title (brand-free, the layout appends the site name), description (120-180 chars), noindex (true hides the page from search), keywords (array, replaces the page's own). Example: "/methodology": { "title": "How We Score Engineering Velocity", "description": "The Scout Score method explained: commit velocity, contributor growth, and repo expansion across 15 sectors." }. Empty overrides object = no active overrides. Optional absolute: true renders the title verbatim (no layout brand suffix); used by the 2026-10 CTR wave so the full title stays under 60 chars.
